title: Verify the hosted wizard installer URL is live before merging onboarding changes that reference it
answers: how do I check the setup.sh wizard URL works before release
the curl wizard command returns 403 or 404 in the docs
verify installer script before publishing onboarding command
body:
The wizard URL https://mlflow.org/wizard/setup.sh is served by the separate mlflow-website deployment, not by this repo. A merged README/docs/UI change that points to it is broken until that deployment is live.
Before merging, confirm the production URL returns HTTP 200 (for example with curl -I) and that the script parses with `sh -n` on the downloaded file. Do not run the installer itself just to verify it.
If the URL returns 403 or is not yet published, deploy the website change first; the docs and AgentActionCard command strings will otherwise lead users to a command that cannot run.
applies: Any PR that changes the public mlflow.org/wizard installer command in README, docs, or the OSS onboarding card.
says: The quickstart installation command copied from the onboarding screen returns a not found error.
New users cannot run the setup wizard script suggested on the welcome card.
The terminal command in the getting started guide fails with an access forbidden error.
Confirm the hosted setup wizard script is published before updating the onboarding instructions.
Ensure the installer command on the product dashboard downloads a valid executable script.
search: Pull requests updating the wizard installer URL https://mlflow.org/wizard/setup.sh in README.md, docs, or AgentActionCard.tsx must verify the URL is live on the mlflow-website deployment before merging. Verification requires checking that the URL returns HTTP 200 with curl -I and that the script passes sh -n syntax parsing on the downloaded file without executing the installer itself. If the URL yields 403 or is unpublished, deploy the website change first so onboarding commands do not break.
